subject: POC timeline & milestones - Acme Industries
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & proposed POC timeline

Hi Sarah

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and next steps so we're aligned:  

Summary / goals
- Objective: Validate Redwood Inference for Acme's internal summarization and retrieval pipelines with a 3-week POC.
- Key success criteria (high level): 1) 30% latency improvement vs current endpoint under 1s median for 512 tokens; 2) parity or better on summary accuracy for 3 core prompt templates; 3) integration stability for scheduled jobs over two weeks.

Proposed timeline (first draft)
- Week 0 (setup): account provisioning, model selection, and data access configuration (approx 2 business days)
- Week 1: baseline runs + initial integration (run parity tests, gather logs)
- Week 2: performance tuning (batching, KV cache) + success criteria validation
- Week 3: final readout + handoff (readout deck + lessons learned)

Owners: Redwood — Marissa (PM) / Rishi (SE); Acme — Sarah (product), engineering lead TBD.

I've attached a short POC plan (acme_poc_plan_v1.pdf) and a checklist. Can you confirm the success criteria above and that the kickoff week of June 22 works for your team?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0182

Attachment: acme_poc_plan_v1.pdf

From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.com>

Subject: Re: Discovery recap & proposed POC timeline

Hi Marissa

Appreciate the clear recap. The high-level success criteria look right; a couple of additions from our side:  
- Add measurable business metric: at least 15% reduction in average time-to-insight for analysts when using Redwood-generated summaries.
- Data/PII note: we'll need a short doc outlining how session data is retained and options for encryption at rest (our security team will ask).

Kickoff: June 22 works for the product/engineering leads. Can we do an initial 60-minute kickoff on Mon, June 22 at 10am PT?

I attached a one-pager with our evaluation checklist (acme_success_criteria.docx). I'll loop in our Eng lead next week once they confirm availability.

—
Sarah

Sarah

Great, June 22 at 10am PT is on our side. Below is an updated, more detailed POC timeline and milestones with owners and deliverables. Please review and flag anything missing.

Updated POC timeline & milestones (3-week engagement)
- Week 0 (Provisioning & kickoff) — Jun 22
  - Kickoff (60 min): Introductions, goals, success criteria sign-off, access plan (Marissa / Sarah)
  - Tasks: provision dedicated trial environment, create service account for Acme, share redwood_poc_checklist.xlsx (Rishi)

- Week 1 (Baseline & integration) — Jun 23–29
  - Deliverables: baseline performance report + integration checklist completed (David)
  - Actions: run baseline workloads (Acme/Sarah); collect logs and token counts; confirm data ingestion pipeline

- Week 2 (Tuning & evaluation) — Jun 30–Jul 6
  - Deliverables: tuned config (batching, quantization recommendation), interim evaluation vs success criteria (Rishi/David)
  - Actions: run comparison tests, iterate on prompts, record latency/accuracy metrics

- Week 3 (Final validation & readout) — Jul 7–13
  - Deliverables: final readout deck, runbook for production rollout, list of follow-up items (Marissa)
  - Actions: executive readout (30–45 min), confirm next steps (procurement/contracting)

Weekly cadence:
- 30-minute check-in every Thursday at 9am PT (Marissa/Rishi + Acme leads)
- Slack channel: we'll create a dedicated channel for quick triage

Open items / asks for Acme
- Confirm engineering lead and provide an initial list of data sources for baseline tests
- Whitelisted IPs for trial environment (Rishi will share IPs once provisioned)
- Completed success criteria doc (thanks for sending yours)

I've attached the POC checklist (redwood_poc_checklist.xlsx) and updated the drive folder with a kickoff agenda and calendar invite. Looking forward to kickoff.

Best,
Marissa

Attachment: redwood_poc_checklist.xlsx
